message: I am thinking...: The PoC should drive the fuzz/xml harness with XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE set, and a main XML document containing two sibling xi:include elements separated by a normal element. The reader processes XIncludes one at a time with a reused xmlXIncludeCtxt; the context's incTab retains the first ref. Streaming reader cleanup can free the first XInclude-start node after leaving it. On processing the second include, xmlXIncludeDoProcess's third phase starts at ctxt->incBase rather than the local start index, so it calls xmlXIncludeIncludeNode for stale index 0 and dereferences ctxt->incTab[0]->ref. Even if local confirmation isn't possible, this matches the public issue and code path.
